The Ruy Lopez is a chess opening that begins 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5. It is
named after Ruy López de Segura, a Spanish priest who analysed it in a book
published in 1561. The Berlin Defence, 3...Nf6, became famous when Vladimir
Kramnik used it against Garry Kasparov in the 2000 World Championship match in

• The main line continues 3...a6, the Morphy Defence, and then 4.Ba4 Nf6
